sql: select * from (select 'event' as kind, created_at as ts, level || ' ' || component || ': ' || left(message, 170) as detail from system_events where created_at >= now() - interval '25 minutes' union all select 'trades/min' as kind, date_trunc('minute', created_at) as ts, count(*)::text || ' trades, ' || count(distinct strategy)::text || ' books' as detail from paper_trades where created_at >= now() - interval '35 minutes' group by date_trunc('minute', created_at)) x order by ts desc
